definition: to leave and start a journey
description: In warm morning light, a man in a round helmet with goggles, sunglasses and a brown leather jacket rides a motorbike with a sidecar away from a stone cottage down a gravel lane. He looks back and smiles, then waves a gloved hand as dust sprays from the back wheel. A rolled green sleeping bag with a map is strapped behind him, and a shaggy grey-and-white dog sits in the sidecar. At the garden gate an older woman, young women and a man wave goodbye and cheer.

de.answer: Er bricht mit einem Motorrad auf.
